EV-GPS-04009 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, weight 0.85): one 70 s gap 23:16:50-23:18:00 at the start, bounding fixes 194.6 m apart, every other interval 10 s or less. No POL-RD-07 limb fires: (a) 70 s is not over 90 s; (b) 194.6 m is not over 500 m; (c) the sustained cadence is 10 s, not over 30 s, and one isolated interval is not a sustained one. The trace therefore establishes the deviation on its own; the cap is 0.85, above the 0.70 floor, and the finding survives the discount because the gap spans only 0.19 km (POL-GEN-02). The driver's statement ('Night time I use expressway because faster') cites no evidence id and invokes no exculpatory clause, so it is discarded (POL-RD-08). Because the deviation is material, EV-DPROF-04009 is consulted: deviation_flags_90d 4 (3 or more) establishes a pattern under POL-RD-06; lifetime prior_deviation_flags 6 is not read (POL-GEN-01). POL-RD-02 figure (METERED, surge_multiplier 1.0 on EV-FARE-04009): recomputed = (3.80 + 0.75 x 10.3 + 0.28 x 17) x 1.0 + 0.80 + 0.00 on-route ERP = 17.085; 27.50 - 17.085 = 10.415, rounded up to 10.45.
